scenarios.then: invoke the installed executor once with the active host; read fixed console api-keys/usage with the matching API key, then public status without a credential; at most two GETs within 30 seconds, no init, catalog, browser login or media preflight

scenarios.when: A command for the bound host returns an active_connection_*, workbuddy_*, or host_credential_adapter_unavailable local failure, including when the user asks to continue generation.
scenarios.then: Stop the automatic API flow. Do not invoke connection, init, doctor, models, another Skill, or another --host as a recovery probe. Preserve the original request and any existing task ID; never resubmit automatically. Explain only that this invocation sent no API request. An explicit recheck request or verified new diagnostic evidence permits one relevant check on the same host; changing host requires explicit user selection.

scenarios.when: usage succeeds with unlimited_quota true and a positive public quota_per_unit
scenarios.then: divide actual total_available by quota_per_unit; default to one concise account wallet balance line in USD; never call the wallet unlimited or subtract used again

scenarios.when: usage succeeds with unlimited_quota false and valid unit metadata
scenarios.then: report current Key remaining allowance in USD, explicitly not account wallet balance; show used and total only on request

scenarios.when: available amount is zero, negative or nonzero below 0.01 USD
scenarios.then: preserve actual zero or overdraft; show a small positive amount as below 0.01 USD instead of zero; never infer infinity

scenarios.when: the user asks for combined balance, subscription funds or a mismatch with the account overview
scenarios.then: Explain that this API reports wallet or Key allowance without subscription quota; offer https://console.puretokensx.com/wallet for wallet and plan information. Do not add or invent amounts, suggest recharge merely because scopes differ, or issue a balance query for a scope-only question.

scenarios.when: a legacy billing limit such as 100000000 is supplied instead of token_usage data
scenarios.then: reject it as unusable, never calculate a balance from the placeholder and never call a legacy fallback endpoint

scenarios.when: the usage request fails authentication, returns an HTTP or logical error, or lacks declared balance fields
scenarios.then: stop after the one request with no amount; report the balance endpoint rejection with its HTTP status and safe API code without declaring the current Key or media connection invalid; if other calls work, preserve the connection and suggest Pure Tokens support; no automatic retry or credential request

scenarios.when: public status fails or quota_per_unit is absent, invalid or non-positive
scenarios.then: report balance unconfirmed without monetary amounts; public metadata rejection does not prove the Key is invalid; do not assume a default divisor, use raw quota as money, or retry

scenarios.when: the user asks if balance covers a generation
scenarios.then: do not infer a price or guarantee payment; compare only an actual quote with matching currency and scope, and let the submission API decide; no balance preflight per media task

scenarios.when: the effective host credential is a bare key accepted by media
scenarios.then: before the first balance usage GET, add sk- once in memory as the official CC Switch import does; preserve existing sk-, suffixes and the configured credential; do not rewrite host files or change other API authentication

scenarios.when: the balance response echoes an original or normalized credential, including JSON escapes
scenarios.then: redact both credential forms before creating a receipt; preserve only safe public error codes and messages

scenarios.when: balance returns 401 or 403 while images, videos or other API calls work
scenarios.then: explain only that balance querying was rejected, preserve the working connection and do not instruct the user to replace the Key or reinstall; retain the safe balance_usage_auth_rejected diagnostic code for support

scenarios.when: the current conversation model can respond and receives an independent API result or an explicit user question
scenarios.then: Only provide relevant user navigation: recognized insufficient quota/balance goes to https://console.puretokensx.com/wallet; explicit unanswerable spending-history questions go to https://console.puretokensx.com/usage-logs. A failure of the conversation model itself cannot be handled by this Skill. Do not add API-key management or channel-status redirects, browser reads or new API calls.

scenarios.when: the user explicitly asks for historical charges, spending details or an individual generation cost that available results cannot confirm
scenarios.then: Offer https://console.puretokensx.com/usage-logs for the user to inspect by time and model. Do not call balance to derive a charge, infer billing from missing records or task status, guarantee refunds, recover unknown task IDs or automatically append the link to every failure.
